scripts.anchor:build: cd apps/contracts && anchor build && cp target/idl/payvand.json ../web/app/assets/payvand.idl.json
scripts.anchor:idl: cd apps/contracts && anchor idl build -o target/idl/payvand.json && npx -y @solana-program/program-metadata --rpc https://api.devnet.solana.com -k ~/.config/solana/id.json write idl 4grKZpw6G2zmxv62iKzr8vCJU2g3oAArpcJEeTFimq3J target/idl/payvand.json && anchor idl fetch 4grKZpw6G2zmxv62iKzr8vCJU2g3oAArpcJEeTFimq3J -o /tmp/payvand-idl-live.json && python3 -c 'import json,sys; live=json.load(open("/tmp/payvand-idl-live.json")); built=json.load(open("target/idl/payvand.json")); sys.exit(0 if live==built else "the on-chain IDL differs from target/idl/payvand.json")'

apps/web/**/*.{vue,ts,js,mjs}: cd apps/web && corepack pnpm exec eslint --fix
cd apps/web && corepack pnpm exec prettier --write
